thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: TOKEN_SIGN_VERIFY_FAILURE fired for service=auth-signing (priority=high) :rotating_light:

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident #INC-8492 triggered. Triggered by rule: jwt-signature-verify-errors > 100/min.

alice (eng-oncall): acked via PD. I'm on it. Jumping into logs now.

bob (eng-sre): i'm looking at signing service metrics. seeing a spike in `signature.verify.latency` and `verify_errors`. Hitting ~250/min across zones.

alice (eng-oncall): customer-reported 401s coming in? dana, can you confirm support?

dana (support-lead): we have ~18 tickets from different customers reporting auth failures, some automated cron jobs failing. severity=high for a handful (payment webhooks).

frank (eng-runtime): stack traces from signing worker show `KMSTimeoutError: request timed out` and `signature verification timed out waiting for keystore`.

carlos (sec-sre): could be KMS SLA blip or a network path issue to KMS cluster. Any config changes rolled recently?

eve (eng-platform): no config changes in the last 6h. Deploys show one canary for routing-proxy but unrelated.

alice (eng-oncall): quick mitigation idea: switch auth service to local fallback signer (ephemeral key) to restore signing/validation while we investigate KMS. frank, how fast?

frank (eng-runtime): we have a fallback mode already gated by feature flag `auth.local-fallback`. I can flip it in ~5-7 min but need approval since this changes key material (will require token rotation).

carlos (sec-sre): security: local fallback ok as temporary mitigation if we rotate keys and notify customers. Need to ensure ephemeral keys are stored only in-memory and no long-term persistence.

alice (eng-oncall): do it. frank, flip `auth.local-fallback=true` in prod canary first, confirm health, then rollout. Add a short TTL for the fallback key (1h).

frank (eng-runtime): running: `kubectl -n prod set env deploy/auth-service AUTH_LOCAL_FALLBACK=true`

incident-bot: Change executed by frank at 2134567975. Automated canary rollout started.

bob (eng-sre): canary latencies look fine. signature.verify errors dropped to ~5/min on canary. Rolling to remaining replicas now.

pagerduty: Reminder: On-call handoff window approaching in 25m.

alice (eng-oncall): rolling completed. overall verify_errors down to baseline. customer 401s should be cleared within TTL. dana, please confirm with customers.

dana (support-lead): contacting top 10 affected customers now, will update in thread when they confirm recovery.

carlos (sec-sre): I'm starting key rotation plan: generate ephemeral key in HSM fallback, issue new signing key, set signing TTL 1h, and ensure old tokens are accepted for a short drift window. Will also request KMS team for incident logs.

frank (eng-runtime): running diagnostic against KMS endpoints: `curl -v https://kms.prod.internal/health` shows intermittent 504s from two IPs. Traceroute shows packet loss to KMS cluster in us-east-1.

alice (eng-oncall): open PD to KMS infra: PD-4321 (escalated). Tagging @kms-oncall.

pagerduty: PD-4321 assigned to kms-oncall.

eve (eng-platform): starting temporary routing bypass to prefer healthy KMS endpoints (region failover) while they investigate. Deploying routing override now.

bob (eng-sre): verify_errors continued dropping after routing override. Looks like majority requests were going to a degraded KMS node. Good catch.

dana (support-lead): Customer updates: 7/18 confirmed recovered, 6 still validating, 5 pending. No new SEV1s. Notifying impacted customers we applied mitigation and are doing key rotation.

carlos (sec-sre): audit: collecting signer logs, will produce an IOCs list and timeline. Also recommend we trigger a post-incident rotation of all signing keys used in last 24h.

alice (eng-oncall): agree. we'll keep local-fallback enabled for 30m while KMS crew resolves root cause. plan for key rotation and communication to customers.

frank (eng-runtime): setting fallback TTL to 30m now: `auth.fallback_ttl=1800s`

incident-bot: Automated note: fallback TTL changed by frank at 2134568140.

eve (eng-platform): KMS team reports they identified a load-balancer misconfiguration that caused a subset of nodes to drop keepalive connections. They are rolling a fix now.

bob (eng-sre): monitoring shows KMS 504s resolved across nodes. After 3m of stability, we should flip off local-fallback and revert routing override.

alice (eng-oncall): plan: flip back to normal in 10m, perform controlled key re-sync, then mark incident as mitigated. Anyone object?

carlos (sec-sre): proceed, but ensure we keep a window for tokens issued under fallback. We'll accept token issued-before timestamp + 2m.

dana (support-lead): continuing customer outreach; will send summary once incident closed.

frank (eng-runtime): disabling `AUTH_LOCAL_FALLBACK` now in canary.

incident-bot: Change executed by frank at 2134568220. Canary revert started.

bob (eng-sre): canary stable. errors remain low. rolling to prod.

incident-bot: Revert completed at 2134568235. auth service running in normal KMS mode.

alice (eng-oncall): closing PD alert in 5m if no regression. Noting postmortem required: root cause KMS LB misconfig, mitigation: local fallback + routing override + key rotation. Owners: eng-runtime, sec-sre, kms infra.

pagerduty: Incident #INC-8492 acknowledged closed by alice at 2134568245.

alice (eng-oncall): great work everyone. I'll start the postmortem doc and link the audit logs. dana, please prepare customer-facing summary. :thumbsup:
